design.arms_can_lose_fills: an arm that spends headroom early REFUSES production extends it can no longer afford; reported per cell
design.independent_inventory: each arm keeps its own up/dn/cost and adjudicates every later gate on it
design.no_imputed_completions: no opposite-side fill is ever invented after a counterfactual extend
design.structural_note: matched = min(up, dn); extra inventory on the side already held cannot become matched unless the opposite side later exceeds the original held quantity

labels: SHADOW ONLY; live residual cap stays 6; UNBOUNDED is a diagnostic measurement of suppressed action mass and is not a live candidate
